props.name: children
props.description: The paragraph. Whitespace is collapsed, as in HTML.

props.name: algorithm
props.description: `optimal` is Knuth–Plass; `greedy` is first-fit, as browsers justify. Useful for comparison.

props.name: hyphenate
props.description: Allow breaks inside words at hyphenation points. Only the optimal breaker hyphenates.

props.name: patterns
props.description: Liang patterns, whitespace-separated, to replace the compact English set.

props.name: tolerance
props.description: How loose a line the first pass accepts (Knuth’s tolerance). Looser passes follow if nothing fits.

props.name: onLayout
props.description: Called after every layout with the lines chosen.

props.name: showRatios
props.description: Show each line’s stretch as a faint bar in the margin.
